descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的表面遍布系统性毁灭的伤疤：残垣断壁、满目疮痍、一片死寂。最初的扫描显示这里曾经存在过一个繁荣的前超光速社会，直到一些事件导致了他们灾难性的终结。四处散落的遗骸低语着一种无法言说的恐怖。
descriptions.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] planet bears the scars of systematic devastation: blasted landscapes, collapsed cities, and an eerie silence. Initial scans suggest a once-thriving pre-FTL society existed here - until something brought about their catastrophic end. The scattered remains whisper of an untold horror.

descriptions.zh: 一场灾难性的能量涌最近击穿了这座巨大的生产设施——这也是无数服务于[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]的类似设施中的一座。之后，我们的探险队会努力调查这些设施是如何建设的，并试着抢救可能还存在着的技术资产，希望能了解这座设施在我们自己的近期历史中可能发挥的作用。
descriptions.en: A catastrophic power surge recently tore through this vast manufacturing facility - one of several which served the [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]. In its wake, our expedition shall endeavor to discover how these facilities came to be, salvage whatever technological assets may still remain, and hopefully learn what role this place may have played in our own recent past.

descriptions.zh: 在[from.planet.GetName]上的漫天黄沙中，曾有某种[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj]监测站感兴趣的东西。其硬件现在已经过于陈旧无法修复，但它甚至比我们发现的几乎所有其他机械制品都要早。可能在我们被同化之前它就开始运作了。虽然现在这里很有可能除了沙漠一无所有，但只有一个办法可以完全确定……
descriptions.en: Somewhere in the sand-swept landscape of [from.planet.GetName] once lay something of interest to a [origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetAdj] monitoring station. The hardware is beyond repair now, and so old, it predates nearly every other machine artifact we've found. It may even have been in operation since before we were assimilated. There is a chance nothing now remains here except desert, but there's one way we might be truly sure...
